As we approach the midterms and the next two years of Trump's current term, I would like to solicit feedback on what you want to see more of, or less of, as far as stickies go.  Would you like stickies to be rotated out at a faster or slower pace? Relevant news 
Formatted correctly 
Current 
Titled properly

Thank you all for being here and thank you for your feedback.
